commands.about:
Place an algo order.

Valid algoTypes and their required flags:
  STOP             --trigger-price
  TP_SL            --tp-trigger-price and/or --sl-trigger-price
  POSITIONAL_TP_SL --tp-trigger-price and/or --sl-trigger-price (quantity must be 0)
  TRAILING_STOP    --callback-rate (1-15%)
  BRACKET          --trigger-price + --tp-trigger-price and/or --sl-trigger-price

Valid sides: BUY, SELL

commands.about: Buy UP or DOWN shares in a Predict round
commands.longAbout:
Buy UP or DOWN shares in an Orderly Predict round.

--price is in the selected direction. DOWN buys are sent to the UP book as SELL orders at 1 - price. Only LIMIT, IOC and POST_ONLY are supported; margin_mode is always ISOLATED. The minimum notional is checked against the UP-book price.

args.name: price
args.help: Limit price in the selected direction (0.01-0.99)

args.name: type_
args.help: Order type: LIMIT, IOC, POST_ONLY (default: LIMIT)

args.name: post_only_adjust
args.help: Adjust a POST_ONLY price by one tick toward the best price

args.name: dry_run
args.help: Print the request payload without signing or sending it

commands.about: Sell (reduce) an existing Predict position
commands.longAbout:
Sell (reduce) an existing UP or DOWN Orderly Predict position.

The order is always reduce_only. --price is in the selected direction. DOWN sells are sent to the UP book as BUY orders at 1 - price.

args.name: price
args.help: Limit price in the selected direction (0.01-0.99)

args.name: type_
args.help: Order type: LIMIT, IOC, POST_ONLY (default: LIMIT)

args.name: post_only_adjust
args.help: Adjust a POST_ONLY price by one tick toward the best price

args.name: dry_run
args.help: Print the request payload without signing or sending it

commands.about: Close (part of) a Predict position with a protected IOC order
commands.longAbout:
Close (part of) an Orderly Predict position with an IOC reduce-only order.

By default the protection price is 2 ticks beyond the best bid/ask. Use --shares for a partial close; the default is the full position.

args.name: dry_run
